question: The main indication for using 4 drugs in the initial treatment of tuberculosis is:

options.opa: Affectation of the central nervous system.
options.opb: High prevalence of primary resistance to isoniazid.
options.opc: Cavitated and extensive pulmonary tuberculosis with large bacillary load.
options.opd: Disseminated tuberculosis associated with HIV infection.
options.ope: Extrapulmonary tuberculosis in immunodepressed patients of any origin.
